paper_title: The Generalized Microscopic Image Reconstruction Problem
statement: Finally, we conjecture that Theorem 6 can be extended to full k-ary trees.
context: Another possible direction is to determine the minimum number of surgical probes in case ` is a binary or integer vector. As mentioned earlier, our results provide an upper bound on the number of required surgical probes. This problem is most likely NP-hard as the work by Gritzmann et al. [9] suggests. Finally, we conjecture that Theorem 6 can be extended to full k-ary trees.
